title.narrative: A Bottom-Up Approach for Protecting and Supporting Civil Human Rights Actors in Post-Pandemic Turkey

description.narrative: The global objective is to boost the human rights struggle in a very oppressive environment through a bottom-up approach; for the promotion and protection of human rights and fundamental freedoms in post-pandemic Turkey. The specific objectives are (1) enhancing the capacity of the human rights movement to create transformative impact in an extremely challenging context; and (2) contributing to the enjoyment of the right to defend human rights.

description.narrative: of incidents of human rights violations revealed and brought to the attention of the public by the HRFT and IHD through this network of incidents of human rights violations revealed and brought to the attention of the public by the HRFT and IHD through this network

comment.narrative: 15 incidents in 2019

The first information note based on these reports was published on January 24 2022. This note provided critical insights into the situation of human rights defenders in Turkey during the period from September 1 2021 to December 31 2021. According to the data presented in the note shared on HRFTs website and social media channels a total of 1220 human rights defenders faced at least one form of intervention during this time frame.The second information note which covers the first four months of 2022 was published on June 1 2022. This note indicates that between January 1 2022 and April 30 2022 a total of 1415 individuals were targeted by one or more forms of intervention including judicial and administrative harassment threats and reprisals due to their involvement in human rights activities. The report provides a detailed breakdown of each type of harassment along with numerical data across various categories.The third information note was produced as an annual report covering the year 2022. This report aimed to highlight the increasing repression obstacles and challenges faced by human rights defenders HRDs in Turkey while also fostering solidarity with them. According to the findings between January 1 and December 31 2022 a total of 4819 individuals experienced one or more forms of intervention including judicial harassment administrative harassment physical violence threats targeting and reprisals. During the same period 16 associations 5 professional organizations and 1 foundation were directly or indirectly targeted and faced judicial and administrative harassment due to their human rights activities. Additionally 311 peaceful meetings demonstrations and marches were disrupted across 34 different cities.
